evidence.title: Drinking hot water, lemon and baking soda will not cure coronavirus
evidence.snippet_en: AP News rated as false the claim that drinking hot water with lemon and bicarbonate of soda at night cures coronavirus and has prevented deaths in Israel.

evidence.title: False claims that drinking water with lemon can prevent COVID-19 ...
evidence.snippet_en: AFP Fact Check rated as false the claim that drinking lemon and warm water can prevent novel coronavirus disease.

evidence.title: Drinking Warm Water With Lemon Does Not Protect You From ...
evidence.snippet_en: BOOM Fact Check rated as false the claim that drinking warm water with lemon slice protects against the novel Coronavirus.

evidence.title: No, Vitamin C and lemon-infused hot water do not protect against ...
evidence.snippet_en: Alt News rated as false the claim that Vitamin C and lemon in hot water protect against coronavirus.

evidence.title: Video falsely claims hot lemon juice can kill coronavirus
evidence.snippet_en: PolitiFact rated as false the claim that slices of lemon in a cup of hot water can save your life by killing the proliferation of the novel coronavirus.

evidence.title: Will Lemons and Hot Water Cure or Prevent COVID-19?
evidence.snippet_en: Snopes.com rated as false the claim that drinking hot water with lemons will cure or prevent COVID-19, or that adding sodium bicarbonate will "alkalize the immune system" and cure or prevent COVID-19.

evidence.title: Lemon Juice Tea Does Not Cure COVID-19 in Israel, or Anywhere ...
evidence.snippet_en: FactCheck.org rated as false the claim that everyone in Israel drinks a cup of hot water with lemon and a little baking soda at night to kill coronavirus, preventing COVID-19 deaths.

evidence.snippet_en: FACTLY rated as false the claim that there are no COVID-19 deaths in Israel because they found a cure for COVID-19, a mixture of lemon and baking soda.
